'The only admissible step is the paired operator' and 'forbids any single-photon pair-production channel'. After the migration the no-crossings argument covers only the φ=0 term γ(0)=1; a general photon γ(φ) has crossings (φ₀σ₀, φ₁σ₁, φ₀₁σ₀σ₁⁻¹), so 'any' single-photon channel is not covered by the stated argument. Also note: at φ=ψ=0 the σ₀σ₁σ₀ coefficient of NF(γγ) is φ₀₁ψ₀+φ₁ψ₀₁=0, so the paired crystal step is not the Gröbner–Shirshov γγ→e⁻ coordinate. PROPOSED: scope 'forbids' to γ(0), or supply the general-φ argument; flagged, not fixed (claim-bearing).
